name: Superficial Peroneal Neuropathy
definition: Entrapment or injury of the superficial peroneal nerve causing dorsum-of-foot sensory symptoms and possible eversion weakness.

typical: Symptoms with exercise or tight footwear

investigations.principle: Electrodiagnostics and ultrasound are used selectively for localization.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, cartilage, ligament or occult injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent focal entrapment may require decompression.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Jangha/Pada Vata-neuropathy phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Entrapment or injury of the superficial peroneal nerve causing dorsum-of-foot sensory symptoms and possible eversion weakness.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, unreduced dislocation, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
